summary.en: Three nine-frame cuts of the product, one beat of black silence, then the opening title fades up and holds.
summary.zh: 三个 9 帧的产品速剪，一拍纯黑静默，然后开场标题淡入、定住。

fits: The first five seconds of a launch film or teaser: a product with three strong frames (a whole page, another page, one close detail) and a title worth a held beat.
notFor: Explainers that must teach from the first second; products without three distinct frames; films with voice-over over the opening (the silence beat must stay silent).

intent.en: Hook the viewer before the film begins: three glimpses of the product's best frames, a breath of black silence, then the name, so the opening says 'this is worth watching' before explaining anything.
intent.zh: 正片开始前先钩住观众：三个产品最抓眼的画面一闪而过，一拍纯黑静默，再亮出名字；什么都还没讲，先让人觉得值得看下去。

content.en: Three strong stills of the product (a whole page, another page, one close detail cropped at about 2.2×), one beat of pure black, and an opening title (the product name or a short line, held at least 40 frames); no voice-over over the opening.
content.zh: 三张产品的强画面（一整页、另一整页、一个约 2.2 倍放大的细节），一拍纯黑，加一个开场标题（产品名或一短句，定住至少 40 帧）；开场不能压旁白。

fits.zh: 发布片或预告片的前 5 秒：产品有三个强画面（一整页、另一页、一个特写细节），标题值得定住一拍。

notFor.zh: 第一秒就要开始教的讲解片；拿不出三个不同画面的产品；开场压着旁白的片子（静默那一拍必须没有声音）。

pairs.note: the quiet title that can fill the lockup slot

en: The black beat must be pure black with nothing on it; it is a breath, not another title card.
Silence the black beat completely; one hit per cut, nothing under the black.
Pick three frames that differ (two pages and a detail); three similar pages read as one.
zh: 黑场必须纯黑、什么都不放；它是喘息，不是又一张字卡。
黑场那一拍完全消音；三连切每切一声打点，黑场下面什么都不垫。
三个画面要有差别（两整页加一个细节）；三张相似的页面读作同一张。

upstream.name: 预告片冷开场
upstream.summary: 预告片语法一式——trailer-bumper 前置速剪钩子：三镜 9f 速剪 + 黑场静默一拍，再开场标题
upstream.use: 预告片的开场钩子（cold open）：正片前先塞三个最抓眼的镜头，再静默一拍正式开场

waive.all: an arc is data with no pixels of its own: the cut lengths (9 frames), the black frame (6 frames, here one beat) and the title's fade and rise (16 frames) are copied as numbers from the upstream timeline and listed in the card

slots.note: three hard cuts of 9 frames each (0.3 s): a whole page, another whole page, one detail at 2.2x; each pushes in 1 → 1.04 at a constant speed so the three read as one breath
pure black and no sound: one beat on the bed's rest section, the breath before the title
the opening title: fades up and rises over 16 frames while its tracking closes from 0.05 em to -0.012 em over 30; after that nothing moves (a held still of at least 40 frames)
